tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Стефанові сьогодні 162 роки! До нього приїхала давня подруга Лексі — весела вампірка, яка знає його понад сто років. Олена трохи ревнує, а Лексі сміється й розповідає, що зробила б, якби знову стала людиною. Ти допомагаєш запалювати свічки на торті — їх аж 162.
tasks.q_pl: Stefan kończy dziś 162 lata! Przyjechała do niego dawna przyjaciółka Lexi — wesoła wampirzyca, która zna go od ponad stu lat. Elena jest trochę zazdrosna, a Lexi się śmieje i opowiada, co by zrobiła, gdyby znów była człowiekiem. Pomagasz zapalać świeczki na torcie — jest ich aż 162.
tasks.q_en: Stefan is 162 today! His old friend Lexi has come to visit: a cheerful vampire who has known him for over a hundred years. Elena is a little jealous, and Lexi laughs and talks about what she would do if she were human again. You're helping to light the candles on the cake, all 162 of them.

tasks.q: Second conditional: unreal or imagined present/future. If + past simple, would + verb: If I were human, I would sunbathe. If Lexi knew, she would escape. Use were for all persons in formal English (If I were you…). It's for dreams, imagination and advice, not real plans (that's the first conditional).
tasks.q_pl: Second conditional: unreal or imagined present/future. If + past simple, would + verb: If I were human, I would sunbathe. If Lexi knew, she would escape. Use were for all persons in formal English (If I were you…). It's for dreams, imagination and advice, not real plans (that's the first conditional).
tasks.q_en: Second conditional: unreal or imagined present/future. If + past simple, would + verb: If I were human, I would sunbathe. If Lexi knew, she would escape. Use were for all persons in formal English (If I were you…). It's for dreams, imagination and advice, not real plans (that's the first conditional).
